That’s why we still offer strong manufacturer-backed warranties, including premium options. But we don’t lead with the number.
We focus on getting the install right, making sure everything is registered correctly, and helping you choose coverage that actually fits your situation.
Choose Houston Roofing & Construction
When it comes to your roofing project, we believe in quality without compromise. Our proven processes, passionate professionals, and unprecedented warranties guarantee you first-class results... and your total peace of mind.
Real Project Managers. Real Oversight.
Your project isn’t handed off to a rotating crew. Our project managers are in-house employees who oversee the job from start to finish—making sure the scope is followed, the install is done right, and nothing gets missed along the way.
Built For Houston—And Still Here After The Storm
We’re not a storm-chasing company that shows up, does the work, and disappears. We’re based here. We work here. And we’re here after the job is done. That means we understand:

Repair Or Replace? We’ll Tell You Straight.

A Process That Doesn’t Miss Details

pages.text:
Commercial roof replacement in Houston TX. Flat and low-slope systems installed with clear planning, coordination, and minimal disruption.
Commercial Roof Replacement Houston, TX
Houston Commercial Roof Replacement With Clear Planning, Coordination, And Oversight
Flat And Low-Slope Roof Replacement & System Installation
For Houston Commercial Properties
Commercial roof installation in Houston depends on planning, coordination, and execution done correctly from the start.
These projects usually involve existing roofs, prior repairs, and conditions that need to be understood before anything is replaced. What’s underneath, how water is moving, and how the system ties into the rest of the building all affect how the new roof should be built.
As a general contractor, Houston Roofing & Construction evaluates the existing roof, documents current conditions, and defines the full scope before work begins. From there, we manage the project start to finish, coordinating materials, crews, and sequencing so the system is installed the way it’s designed to perform.
You’re not piecing decisions together mid-project or reacting as problems show up. You’re working from a defined plan built around the property.
When Commercial Roof Replacement Makes Sense
Not every commercial roof needs to be replaced right away, but there’s a point where continued repairsand coatings stop being practical.
Replacement is typically the better option when the system is showing widespread wear, repairs are becoming more frequent, or performance is declining across multiple areas.
Repeated Repairs
If the same issues keep coming back, it often indicates system-wide deterioration, such as membrane wear, seam failure, or breakdown across multiple sections of the roof. Temporary fixes may solve the immediate problem, but they don’t address the underlying wear across the roof.
Over time, repair costs add up, and disruptions become more frequent. At that point, replacement often becomes the more practical and cost-effective path forward.
Widespread Wear
Commercial roofing systems don’t fail all at once. They deteriorate over time across multiple areas. Membrane wear, seam separation, and material breakdown across large sections of the roof are indicators that the system is nearing the end of its usable life. When deterioration is no longer localized, repairs become less effective and harder to manage consistently.
Drainage Problems
Standing water and poor drainage are among the most common causes of commercial roof failure. If water isn’t moving off the roof properly, it accelerates material breakdown and increases the risk of leaks.
While minor drainage issues can sometimes be corrected, widespread ponding often points to larger system limitations that are better addressed during replacement.
Planning & Budget Control
Waiting until a roof fails forces decisions under pressure. Replacing the system on your timeline allows for better coordination, budgeting, and planning. It also gives you the opportunity to select the right system for the building instead of reacting to an urgent issue. Proactive replacement helps reduce long-term costs and avoids unexpected disruptions to operations.
What A Commercial Roof Replacement Involves
Commercial roof replacement is more than an overlay or removing the old system and installing a new one. We see your building as a whole. It requires a proper inspection, the right system selection, and work coordination so the building continues to operate.
Full System Removal & Prep
We start with a controlled tear-off of the existing system, removing materials down to a suitable substrate. Then we identify underlying issues, address problem areas, and prepare the surface properly.
System Selection & Installation
We install the roofing system that best fits the building. That may include metal, TPO, modified bitumen, or other flat or low-slope roofing systems, depending on structure, usage, and goals. Each system is installed according to manufacturer’s requirements and best practices.
Drainage & Detail Work
Water management is one of the most important parts of a commercial roof. We address drainage, slope, and key detail areas so water moves off the roof properly. This helps prevent ponding, leaks, and long-term system breakdown.
Project Coordination & Oversight
Commercial projects require coordination. Our in-house project managers oversee the process, working with specialized commercial crews to keep the project on track and minimize disruption. You’ll know what’s happening and what to expect at every stage.

How Long Does A Commercial Roof Replacement Take?
It depends on the size of the building and the system being installed, but most commercial roof projects are completed in a few weeks, and we work to minimize disruption.
Can My Business Stay Open During Replacement?
In most cases, yes. Projects are coordinated to reduce impact on daily operations.

We evaluate the structure, usage, and goals of the property and walk you through the options.
Is It Better To Repair Or Replace?
That depends on the condition of the system and the cost of ongoing repairs versus replacement.
What Kinds Of Systems Do You Install?
We install TPO, Mod Bit, PVC, metal, and more. We also do roof coatings.
What Affects The Cost Of Replacement?
Size, system type, condition of the existing roof, and complexity all factor into cost.

pages.text:
Commercial roof repair in Houston TX. Fix leaks, membrane damage, and drainage issues on flat and low-slope roofing systems.
Commercial Roof Repair For Houston, TX
Commercial Roof Repair That Starts With Understanding The System
Flat & Low-Slope Roof Repair For Houston Commercial Properties
Commercial roof repair in Houston focuses on identifying the cause of the issue, including drainage, flashing, membrane condition, and system performance.
With a background in commercial construction, at Houston Roofing & Construction, we approach repairs by looking at the full system, not just the visible problem. That means identifying underlying issues, evaluating how the roof is performing overall, and determining whether a repair will actually solve the problem.
Here, storms, heat, wind, and ongoing exposure create conditions where small issues can turn into larger ones quickly. We address problems early, minimize disruption, and avoid unnecessary repairs that don’t hold up over time.
Common Commercial Roof Problems
Most commercial roof issues start small, but they rarely stay that way.
1. Leaks & Water Intrusion
Leaks are often caused by failed seams, flashing issues, or penetrations where water can enter the roofing system. Identifying the source correctly is critical to making a repair that lasts.
2. Ponding Water
Standing water puts stress on the roofing system and accelerates wear. Over time, it can lead to membrane breakdown and increased risk of leaks.
3. Membrane Damage
Cracks, punctures, and general wear can occur from weather exposure or foot traffic. These issues may be repairable depending on the extent and location.
4. Storm-Related Damage
High winds, debris, and heavy rain can loosen materials or create vulnerabilities that aren’t always immediately visible but can lead to problems later.
Our Approach To Commercial Roof Repair
Commercial roof repair involves choosing the right repair method based on system condition, material type, and the source of the issue.
Full-System Evaluation
We inspect the entire roof, including membrane, flashing, drainage, and surrounding areas to understand overall system performance. This helps us understand how the system is performing and whether the issue is isolated or part of a larger pattern.
Root Cause Identification
Instead of treating symptoms, we focus on identifying the source of the problem. That could be drainage, installation details, or material wear. Fixing the cause leads to longer-lasting repairs.
Targeted Repair Work
When a repair makes sense, we address the issue directly using the appropriate method for the system. The goal is to resolve the problem without unnecessary work or overbuilding the solution.
Project Oversight & Coordination
Our in-house project managers oversee each repair to ensure the work is completed correctly and coordinated with your operations. Even smaller repairs benefit from structured oversight.
Commercial Roof Repair Work Across Houston Properties
A look at commercial roof repair projects completed on buildings throughout the Houston area.
What Property Owners Say About Our Repair Work
Hear from commercial clients who have trusted us to diagnose and repair roofing issues on their properties.
Common Commercial Roof Repair Questions
How Quickly Can You Respond To A Roof Leak?
Response time depends on current conditions and demand, but we prioritize urgent issues to help stabilize the situation quickly.
Can All Commercial Roof Problems Be Repaired?
Not always. Some issues are better addressed through replacement, especially if the system is near the end of its life. A commercial roof inspection will give you the information you need to make an educated decision.
Will Repairs Disrupt My Business Operations?
We coordinate repairs to minimize disruption and keep your building functioning as normally as possible.
How Long Do Repairs Typically Last?
That depends on the condition of the system and the type of repair. Properly identified and executed repairs will last longer than temporary fixes.
Do You Provide Documentation Of The Repair?
Yes. We document what we find and what’s repaired so you have a clear record of the work performed.
What Areas Around Houston Do You Serve?
You’ll find Houston Roofing & Construction in communities across the region, including Tomball, Conroe, Katy, Pearland, Sugarland, The Woodlands, and Humble. See our service areas page for a detailed map.
